name: ToolCalls
usage: Tool calls of an agent (search, file reads, API calls), multi-step tasks, background jobs of an assistant

types.name: ToolCallItem
types.summary: One tool call or step of ToolCalls.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Stable key of the step (the ID of the tool call).

fields.name: title
fields.description: What the step does, such as "Search the web" or the name of the tool.

fields.name: status
fields.description: State of the step, always shown as an icon and a text.

fields.name: description
fields.description: A short summary under the title, such as the query or the file name.

fields.name: input
fields.description: The arguments of the call. Strings are shown as they are, other values as indented JSON.

fields.name: output
fields.description:
The result of the call. Strings are shown as they are, other values as indented JSON; long results scroll
inside their code block.

fields.name: error
fields.description: Why the step failed, shown under the title without expanding the details.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description:
Each step shows its state as an icon and a text. Steps with an `input` or `output` can be expanded to show them
as JSON; the reason of a failure is always visible.

examples.name: Running
examples.title: Running steps
examples.description: Update `status` as the agent works: waiting steps, the running one with a spinning icon, then the result.
